The life of a session: nothing before initialize, what the server says it
can do, a document opened, changed, saved and closed, and the end.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
lint:
  rules:
    unused-suppression: warning
-- lib/obj/a.c --
void f() {
    a == 1;
}
-- script --
request textDocument/formatting {"textDocument":{"uri":"file:///nowhere.c"}}
initialize lib
request initialize {"capabilities":{}}

open lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
received window/logMessage
watchers

# An incremental change: the comparison becomes an assignment.
change lib/obj/a.c 1:6-1:8 "="
text lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
# A change of the whole text, as a client without ranges sends it.
replace lib/obj/a.c "void f() {\n    a == 1; /* dgdtools-ignore lint/sscanf-format */\n}\n"
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
save lib/obj/a.c
diagnostics lib/obj/a.c
# Closing takes the document's diagnostics away.
close lib/obj/a.c
received textDocument/publishDiagnostics

request workspace/symbol {"query":"f"}
shutdown
request textDocument/formatting {"textDocument":{"uri":"file:///nowhere.c"}}
exit
